[i]Ruin has come to our family.[/i]

This game is a great test of planning and being adaptive. You'll find yourself in both best case scenarios and worst possible outcomes, this game tests your skills to maximize the good and minimize the bad. It'll teach you to roll with the punches, that you're not always in control, and that's okay.

If you like planning, getting attached to your warriors, turn based combat, dungeon crawling and eldritch horrors, this game's right up your alley.

[i]Remind yourself that overconfidence is a slow and insidious killer.[/i]

Darkest Dungeon is a beautiful looking turnbased dungeoncrawler set in gothic world that reeks of madness, obession and cosmic horror. The game is narrated by the late great Wayne June which booming great voice is artistic perfect for lovecraftian horror.

Tacticts is a important part of the game, both understanding the game mechanics , it's characters and monsters. be prepared! make sure to stock up on provisions before embarking on an adventure.

You will suffer, your characters will suffer, and die and yes, syphilis is included in this ancestral created nightmare. Stress and afflictions is managed in the hamlet through the abby and sanitorium, the guild and blacksmith is also important buildings, make sure to upgrade them. To enjoy this game you must learn it and try to master it even if you fail many times along way towards the darkest dungeon. learn these words, and live by them:

"Remind Yourself That Overconfidence Is A Slow And Insidious Killer."

I highly recommend this game but i don't recommend it for everyone. It takes a certain type of player to actually enjoy this sort of suffering but if you are like me, and have realised the cosmos is a harsh mistress, it might be just right for you aswell. = )

[h1]Ruin has come to my free time, and I love it[/h1]

This game mentally destroys you, yet walking away is impossible. The atmospheric dread hits immediately, powered by Wayne June's narration which sets a dark tone and triggers goosebumps with every step into the dungeons. Expect a brutal, uncompromising experience, but scraping your party through a boss fight on single-digit health yields unmatched satisfaction.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Key Highlights[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Atmosphere & Narrator:[/b] Legendary voice acting that sells the horror and madness.
[*] [b]Brutal Challenge:[/b] High stakes where tactical errors cost veteran heroes.
[*] [b]Top-tier DLCs:[/b] The Crimson Court and The Color of Madness add brilliant mechanics, fresh threats, and immense replay value.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

If you enjoy deep tactical planning and aren't afraid to watch your favorite heroes collapse into madness, pick this up immediately.
